Shrink video size without losing visual clarity

Pick the size you need and Video Compressor does the rest on your phone. Smart compression lowers the resolution only when the target really needs it, and a 5-second preview shows the result before you start.

GET IT ONGoogle Play
  • Nothing is uploaded

  • No watermark
Nothing is uploaded

Real result−89%

142.8 MB15.8 MB

1080p clip · Messaging target

One-tap target sizes

Pick a size. It fits.

Choose where the video is going and the app aims just under that limit. You see the estimated size before you start.

  • 16 MB

    Messaging & chat

    Stays under the common limit of messaging apps, ready to send in a chat.

  • 10 MB

    Community & server uploads

    Fits the upload cap of chat communities and group servers.

  • 25 MB

    Email attachments

    Small enough to attach to an email instead of sending a link.

  • Any MB

    Custom MB

    Type any size you need. If it is too small for a clean picture, the app suggests one that works.

Never a bigger file than the original

If a video is already efficiently compressed and the result would come out larger, your original is kept. You never end up with more megabytes than you started with.

Hardware speed & privacy

A fast engine that never leaves your phone

Built on Android Media3, the same media framework Android itself uses, with your phone's own hardware video encoders.

  • H.264
  • HEVC (H.265)
  • AV1
  • MP4
  • Media3

Hardware H.264, HEVC and AV1

Hardware-accelerated encoding on phones that support each codec. H.264 plays everywhere; HEVC and AV1 squeeze more quality into fewer megabytes.

Keeps going with the screen off

Lock your phone and compression continues in the background. A notification tells you when it is done.

Zero cloud uploads

Your videos are processed on your phone and never sent to a server. It works in airplane mode too.

Check the quality first

Encode a 5-second sample and drag the before/after slider over the same frame, with a clear Excellent, Good or Low hint.

All-in-one video tools

More than a compressor

Every tool runs on your phone and saves a new file. Your original stays where it is.

  • Trim

    Keep only the part you need.

  • Extract audio

    Save the sound as M4A (AAC).

  • Social ratio

    Reframe to 9:16, 1:1 or 4:5.

  • Merge

    Join several clips into one video.

  • Speed

    Make slow-motion or fast-forward clips.

  • Batch compression

    Queue many videos and let them finish in the background.

Also in the app: crop, rotate and flip, mute, change volume, loop, and convert to an MP4 that plays everywhere.

Take a look

Calm screens, clear numbers

How it works

Smaller video in three steps

  1. 1

    Pick a video

    The system picker shares only the videos you choose. No storage permission is needed.

  2. 2

    Choose a target

    Tap Messaging, Community, Email or type your own MB. Check the preview if you like.

  3. 3

    Share or save

    The new file is saved to Movies/VideoCompressor, ready to share. Your original is untouched.

Private by design

Your videos stay yours

Video Compressor has no account and no server of its own. Compression and editing happen entirely on your device.

  • Videos are never uploaded
  • No account, no sign-in
  • No storage permission: you pick the videos
  • Location can be removed before you share
  • No analytics or tracking SDK

Pricing

Free does the real job

Free

Everything you need to compress

  • Unlimited single videos
  • No watermark
  • All target sizes and custom MB
  • Batches of 3 videos, 3 more after a short ad
  • All tools; some advanced options open after a short ad

Pro

Weekly, monthly or yearly

  • No ads
  • No batch limit
  • HEVC and AV1 without an ad
  • Tighter target size margin
  • Every advanced tool option

The yearly plan may include a 3-day free trial. Prices are shown in Google Play before you pay. Subscriptions renew automatically until you cancel in Google Play.

FAQ

Questions, answered

Is Video Compressor free?

Yes. You can compress unlimited single videos with no watermark. Pro removes ads, lifts the batch limit and unlocks HEVC and AV1 without watching an ad.

Are my videos uploaded anywhere?

No. All compression and editing runs on your phone. Your videos never go to a server, and the app also works offline.

Can the result be bigger than my original?

No. If a video is already efficiently compressed and the result would be larger, the app keeps your original instead.

Will my video lose quality?

Smart compression keeps visual clarity and lowers the resolution only when the target size really needs it. Encode a 5-second preview and compare before and after on the same frame before you start.

Which target size should I choose?

16 MB for messaging apps, 10 MB for chat communities and group servers, 25 MB for email attachments, or type any custom size.

Does it keep working with the screen off?

Yes. Compression continues in the background with the screen off, and a notification tells you when it is finished.

Where are my compressed videos saved?

In Movies/VideoCompressor on your phone, and extracted audio in Music/VideoCompressor. Your original video stays where it was.

How do I cancel my subscription?

Open Google Play › Profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions, choose Video Compressor and tap Cancel. Pro stays on until the end of the period you paid for.

Privacy Policy

Effective: November 26, 2026 · Applies to: Video Compressor for Android (com.durusoft.videocompressor.size.reducer.converter), version 1.0 and later

The short version

  • Your videos never leave your device. Compression, trimming, merging and every other edit happen on your phone. We do not upload, store or share your videos.
  • No account, no sign-in. We do not ask for your name or email to use the app.
  • Ads come from Google AdMob on the free plan, with consent handled by Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) where the law requires it. Pro shows no ads.
  • Subscriptions are handled by Google Play and checked through RevenueCat with an anonymous ID. We never see your payment details.
  • No analytics or crash-reporting SDK is built into the app.
  • We do not sell your personal data.
Contents

  2. Data at a glance

1Who we are

Video Compressor is an Android app published on Google Play by DuruSoft, based in Türkiye ("we", "us"). For the limited personal data described here that we decide about, we are the data controller. Google and RevenueCat act as separate controllers or as our processors for the services they provide. You can reach us at duru.sofft@gmail.com.

2Data at a glance

Every type of data the app touches, where it goes and why. It matches what we declare in the Google Play "Data safety" section.

DataWhere it goesPurpose
Videos you pick, and the videos and audio files the app createsYour device onlyCompressing and editing what you asked for
History of past jobs (file name, size, date), settings and preferencesYour device onlyShowing your history and running the app as you set it up
Location and capture date stored inside a video fileYour device onlyKept or removed in the new file, as you choose in Settings
Advertising ID, IP address and the approximate location it reveals, device and app information, ad interactions, consent choices (free plan only)Google (AdMob, UMP)Showing and measuring ads, preventing fraud, asking for and storing consent
Purchase information (product, purchase token, subscription state) and an anonymous app user IDGoogle Play, RevenueCatSelling, checking and restoring Pro
IP address and app version when the app checks for updatesGitHub (hosting of our version file)Telling you when a new version is available
Your email address and what you write to usOur inboxAnswering you

Video Compressor has no server of its own. It does not request your GPS location, read your contacts or messages, or open any video you did not pick or share with it.

Legal bases. Ads: your consent where the law requires it (EEA, UK, Switzerland), otherwise our legitimate interest in funding the free plan. Purchases: performing our contract with you. Update checks: our legitimate interest in keeping the app working. Messages you send us: answering your request. Under Türkiye's Personal Data Protection Law (KVKK), the same uses rely on Article 5(2)(c) and (f), and on your explicit consent under Article 5(1) where it is needed.

3Your videos stay on your device

All video processing uses Android's built-in Media3 framework and the hardware encoders of your phone. We cannot access any of the following, and the app does not upload it:

  • Videos you pick. You choose videos with the Android system photo picker, or share them to the app from another app. The app receives only those videos; it has no permission to read your gallery.
  • Results. New videos are saved to Movies/VideoCompressor and extracted audio to Music/VideoCompressor on your device. Temporary working files stay in the app's private cache and are removed by the app or by Android.
  • History. A list of past jobs (file name, sizes, date and status) is kept in the app's local database so you can find your results again.
  • Settings. Theme, default target, codec choice and similar preferences are stored locally.

Your original video is never changed. It is deleted only if you tap Delete Original on the result screen and confirm.

4Location and capture date in videos

Video files can contain the place and time they were recorded. Video Compressor handles this metadata only on your device:

  • Capture date is always kept in the new file.
  • Location follows your choice in Settings › Location in output videos: removed for sharing targets (the default), always removed, or always kept. Nothing about it is sent anywhere.
  • The app does not ask for permission to read media location. The Android photo picker may hide location before the app sees the file.

5Permissions and why

  • INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: for ads, purchases and the update check. Videos are never sent over the internet.
  • POST_NOTIFICATIONS (optional): progress and completion notifications, created on your device.
  • FOREGROUND_SERVICE, FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DATA_SYNC and FOREGROUND_SERVICE_MEDIA_PROCESSING: to keep compressing in the background, even with the screen off. WAKE_LOCK is used by Android's WorkManager for the same purpose.
  • WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE (Android 8 and 9 only): to save results to your gallery on older Android versions. Newer versions need no storage permission.
  • com.android.vending.BILLING: to process purchases through Google Play.
  • AD_ID and ACCESS_ADSERVICES_*: the advertising ID and Android's Privacy Sandbox, used by AdMob on the free plan.

The app has no permission to read your photos, videos or files. You can refuse or withdraw notifications at any time in Android Settings without losing any compression feature.

6Advertising and your consent

On the free plan, Video Compressor shows ads from Google AdMob: banner, native, interstitial and rewarded ads. Rewarded ads are always your choice, for example to unlock a larger batch or the HEVC and AV1 codecs once. No ads are shown while a video is compressing. Ads never use your videos, file names or history.

AdMob may collect and use your advertising ID, IP address and the approximate location it reveals, device and app information, and ad interactions, to show and measure ads and prevent fraud. This can include personalized ads based on your interests.

Your choices. In the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, Switzerland and where required elsewhere, the app asks for your choice through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) before ads are personalized. "Do not consent" is a valid answer and the app works the same, with non-personalized or limited ads where the law allows them. Where this applies, you can change your choice at any time in Settings › Ad privacy choices. You can also delete or reset your advertising ID in Android Settings › Privacy › Ads (or Google › Ads), and manage ad personalization in My Ad Center. Pro users see no ads.

See how Google uses information from apps that use its services and Google's Privacy Policy.

7Purchases and subscriptions

Video Compressor Pro (weekly, monthly or yearly) is sold through Google Play Billing. Google Play processes your payment; we never receive or store your card or payment details.

To check and restore your Pro status, the app uses RevenueCat, a subscription service. RevenueCat receives an anonymous app user ID created on your device, the product you bought, the Google Play purchase token and subscription state, the store country and currency, basic device and app information, and your IP address. It does not receive your name, email address or videos, and we do not use this data for advertising.

See RevenueCat's Privacy Policy, Google's Privacy Policy and the Google Play Terms of Service.

8Other services

  • Update check. The app downloads a small version file from our website on GitHub Pages to tell you when an update is available. Like any website, GitHub receives your IP address and the app version; see the GitHub Privacy Statement.
  • Ratings. The app may show Google Play's in-app review window. Google handles your rating; we only see public reviews.
  • Sharing. When you tap Share, Android sends the file to the app you choose. What happens next is governed by that app's own policy.
  • No analytics. The app contains no analytics, crash-reporting or tracking SDK.

9Device backup

If Android backup is turned on, Android may include the app's local job history and settings in your device backup. Your Pro status and ad counters are excluded. The videos saved in Movies/VideoCompressor are ordinary gallery files, so your own gallery or cloud photo backup settings decide whether they are backed up.

10When you contact us

If you email us, we receive your email address and what you write, including the app version and device model that the app adds to support emails. We use this only to answer you and fix the issue you report, and we delete it when it is no longer needed, at the latest two years after our last exchange.

11Sharing and selling

We do not sell or rent your personal data. Data reaches only the services named in this policy, for the purposes stated. We may disclose information if the law requires it.

12Retention and deletion

Data on your device stays until you delete it in the app, clear the app's data or uninstall it. Google, RevenueCat and GitHub keep data under their own policies. For step-by-step instructions to delete your data, cancel a subscription, reset your advertising ID or ask us to delete purchase records, see Delete Your Data.

13Your rights

Depending on where you live (for example under the GDPR, UK GDPR, KVKK or US state privacy laws), you may have the right to access, correct, delete or restrict the use of your personal data, to receive it in a portable form, to object to its use, and to withdraw consent. If you are in Türkiye, you have the rights listed in KVKK Article 11. Because we hold very little about you, most of these actions are done on your device. For data held by RevenueCat or Google, write to us and we will help you. You can also complain to your local data protection authority.

14Children

Video Compressor is not directed to children under 13 (or the minimum age in your country) and does not knowingly collect personal information from them. If you believe a child has provided us with personal information, contact us and we will delete it.

15Security

Your videos are processed and stored on your device. Connections to the services named here use HTTPS. No method is perfect, but we keep what leaves your device to the minimum described in this policy.

16International transfers

Google, RevenueCat and GitHub may process data in countries other than your own, including the United States, under safeguards such as standard contractual clauses. Your videos are never transferred anywhere.

17Changes to this policy

If this policy changes in a material way, we update the effective date above and, where appropriate, tell you in the app.

18Contact

Delete Your Data

Last updated: November 26, 2026 · Video Compressor for Android (com.durusoft.videocompressor.size.reducer.converter) by DuruSoft

In short

  • There is no account. Video Compressor keeps your videos, history and settings only on your device, so most data is deleted right on your phone.
  • Ad data is controlled with the in-app ad privacy choices and your Android advertising ID.
  • Purchase records kept by our subscription service can be deleted on request by email. We reply within 7 days and complete deletion within 30 days.

1. Videos and history on your device

Delete one item from the history:

  1. Open the History tab in Video Compressor.
  2. Tap More options on an item, then Delete, and confirm. The item is removed from the app.

Delete the video or audio files the app created: open your gallery or the Files app and delete them from Movies/VideoCompressor (videos) or Music/VideoCompressor (audio). Deleting a history item does not delete these gallery copies.

Delete an original video: on the result screen, tap Delete Original and confirm, or delete it in your gallery.

Delete all app data at once (history, settings and temporary files):

  1. Open Android Settings › Apps › Video Compressor.
  2. Tap Storage (or Storage & cache), then Clear data (or Clear storage).
  3. Or tap Uninstall to remove the app and all of its private data.

Clearing data or uninstalling does not delete the videos already saved to Movies/VideoCompressor, so you keep your results. Delete them in your gallery if you want them gone too.

2. Advertising ID and consent choices

Change or withdraw your ad consent (shown where the law requires a consent choice, such as in the EEA and the UK):

  1. Open Video Compressor › Settings.
  2. Tap Ad privacy choices and change your choice. Clearing the app's data also resets your stored consent, and the app asks again.

Delete or reset your advertising ID:

  1. Open Android Settings › Privacy › Ads (on some phones: Google › Ads).
  2. Tap Delete advertising ID (Android 12 and later) or Reset advertising ID.

You can also manage ad personalization in My Ad Center. Data that Google has already collected through ads is handled under Google's Privacy Policy, where you can also request deletion from your Google account.

3. Subscription and purchase records: deletion request

Video Compressor has no analytics and no account, so there are no usage or profile records to delete. If you bought Pro, our subscription service RevenueCat keeps a purchase record linked to an anonymous ID. To have it deleted:

  1. If you have an active subscription, cancel it first in Google Play › Profile › Payments & subscriptions › Subscriptions. Deleting data does not cancel a subscription.
  2. Send an email to duru.sofft@gmail.com with the subject line Data Deletion Request — Video Compressor.
  3. Include your Google Play order number (it starts with GPA. and is in your Google Play receipt email) so we can find the record. Do not send passwords or payment card details.

What happens next: we confirm your request within 7 days and delete the purchase record within 30 days at the latest, then confirm by email. We may keep a minimal record of the request itself, and Google may keep order records it must keep for tax and legal reasons under its own policy. After deletion, Pro can no longer be restored to a device through the app.
